audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1, levels 4-5 and level 6 were marked Skill while the whys on the same page said 'Riven's level-1 Q and W stun burst out-trade you instantly', 'her animation-cancel burst still beats your walk-ups' and 'Level 6 favors her'. The 2+ items row was Riven against a whys line describing Yone finally scaling.
audit.why: 46.56% over 2356 games is Yone's worst row in this slice, and the packet chart gives Riven every stage but the last. The mirror (riven__yone) already set levels 4-5 and level 6 to Riven and the 2+ items row to Skill — Riven's combo still kills a Yone who misplays even at two items.
audit.corrected: Level 1, levels 4-5 and level 6 set to Riven; 2+ items set to Skill. Matched full/content pairs with ratings and the affected why lines rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told the player to trade 'once her Q stacks and E are burned' without ever giving a cooldown for Ki Burst, Valor or Broken Wings.
audit.why: Ki Burst is 11/10/9/8/7s, Valor 10/9/8/7/6s and Broken Wings a single 13s cooldown carrying all three casts. Those numbers are the entire lane: at rank 1 there is a real window, by rank 5 there is barely one.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, phases[0].why, phases[3].why and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Wind Slash was called an execute in three places ('executes you after her Q-W-E combo', 'executes low targets'). Riot's text describes Blade of the Exile as bonus AD and range granting one use of Wind Slash, a powerful ranged attack — there is no execute threshold. Three fields also credited Yone with 'W sustain'; Spirit Cleave shields, it does not heal. Fate Sealed was again described as setting up knockups.
audit.why: Riot ability text in the brief; the mirror recorded the identical Wind Slash correction, so both directions now match. An execute claim changes when a player thinks he is safe, which is exactly the kind of error that gets someone killed at 40% HP.
audit.corrected: Wind Slash restated as one ranged missile per ultimate on 60-120s, Yone's 'sustain' replaced with Spirit Cleave's 14s shield, and Fate Sealed restated as blink-behind-and-pull.

audit.whatIsWrong: The itemization panel says 'Executioner's Calling early — his healing fights your pattern', and breakdown.late says anti-heal stays core.
audit.why: Riven has no healing anywhere in her kit — Valor is a shield, and nothing else in the kit heals. This is boilerplate carried in from a sustain matchup, and it costs the player a real item slot.
audit.corrected: Executioner's Calling recommendation removed from report[8].t and the anti-heal clause removed from breakdown.late.

edits.before: Fate Sealed sets up team knockups nothing can dodge. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Riven's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Fate Sealed blinks behind her and pulls, it is not a knockup — but Blade of the Exile adds range and a Wind Slash to finish you.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Riven carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in it evens: your pattern is online, but one clean Riven combo still deletes you. Fight only after her E is spent.

edits.before: She stays firmly ahead through 6 because Wind Slash (R) executes low targets right after her combo, and her E shield plus Flash means your Fate Sealed (R) all-in usually gets shielded and answered. edits.after: She stays firmly ahead through 6: Blade of the Exile (R) gives AD and range plus one Wind Slash missile — powerful, but not an execute — and Valor's shield answers your Fate Sealed all-in. Freeze or hug tower, dodge the W stun on its 7-11s, and trade only once her Q stacks and E are burned.

edits.before: After your second item the lane finally turns: Riven is a front-loaded snowball champ, and your BORK/Kraken DPS with W sustain and R re-engage outscale her once fights go long. Force extended skirmishes, bait the E shield early, and run her down when her combo is on cooldown.
edits.after: After your second item the lane finally evens: Riven is front-loaded, and your BORK/Kraken DPS with Spirit Cleave's 14s shield and R re-engage catch up once fights go long. Force extended skirmishes, bait Valor's shield early, and run her down while her combo is on cooldown.

notes: Wind Slash is not an execute — Riot's text is bonus AD, bonus range and one use of a powerful ranged attack. The page said 'executes you' three times, which changes when a player believes he is safe. Also removed the Executioner's Calling recommendation: Riven has no healing in her kit, so that item slot was being wasted on every game played off this page. Yone's 'W sustain' corrected to Spirit Cleave's shield throughout.
